name: whatsapp
title: Your own WhatsApp bot
description: A WhatsApp business number on Meta's Cloud API — people message it, an agent answers. Messages arrive by webhook, so Meta must be able to reach this instance.

phone_number_id.label: Phone number ID
phone_number_id.hint: From the Meta app's WhatsApp → API Setup page — the ID, not the number itself. The setup wizard asks for it.

waba_id.label: WhatsApp Business Account ID
waba_id.hint: On the same API Setup page, next to the Phone number ID.

app_id.label: App ID
app_id.hint: The Meta app (App settings → Basic) — its webhook is subscribed to this number.

allowed_senders.label: Allowed senders
allowed_senders.hint: Who may drive the owning agent from this number — phone numbers with country code, digits only, one per line. Empty allows nobody.

verify_token.label: Webhook verify token
verify_token.hint: Made by the setup and held by the hub, which answers Meta's webhook check with it.

test_recipient.label: Test recipient
test_recipient.hint: Your own number, proven in test mode.

group.label: Group
group.hint: One group of this number (its group id): this source is that group alone, and everyone in it may write. Empty is the number itself.
